help.notifyP1: In your phone's system settings, [Allow notifications] must be on for this app; at the bottom of the notification settings there is [Message push], tap into it and turn that on too.
help.notifyP2: In your phone's system settings, sound alerts must be on. The phone must not be in silent / Do Not Disturb mode.
help.notifyP3: On Android, check Settings → Sound → Notification sound and make sure the ringtone file is not set to “None”; on iOS 17.2 or later, check Settings → Sounds & Haptics → Default alerts and confirm that an alert tone is selected.
help.notifyP4: If Android still gets no alerts, also check: ① [App → Allow notifications → is it set to Important]; ② the notification switches for the lock screen; ③ set notification filtering to [Important]; ④ whether background data is available; ⑤ the auto-start setting; ⑥ set the battery policy to Unrestricted (or Battery → App launch → allow background activity, secondary launch and auto-start).
help.notifyP5: On Android phones, lock the app in the task switcher so it keeps running in the background and stays online.
help.notifyP6: On iOS, check [Settings → this app → Notifications].
help.certTitle: Why does the account show as unverified
help.certP1: Only accounts registered with a real email address show as verified (this system does not offer phone-number verification). If the administrator has not enabled email sign-up, the unverified state cannot be changed! Please contact the administrator.

feature.item1: The client is not a web page in a shell: it is written natively in Flutter, so chats, calls and file transfers all go through native channels (the built-in browser is only used to open external web pages).
feature.item2: On the desktop: sign in by scanning a QR code with your phone; chats, calls and Media each open in their own window; closing a window keeps the app online in the tray; the installer has a wizard, and uninstalling can be done in Windows Settings > Apps.
feature.item3: Messages: text, emoji, images, files and voice messages, with quoting, forwarding, recall and single-message delete; a received voice message can be turned into text with one tap.
feature.item4: Group chat: create a group, invite and remove members, appoint admins and transfer management rights; group announcement, group mute and a group QR code; new members can read earlier messages.
feature.item5: Audio and video calls: one-to-one voice and video calls, with camera switching and minimizing to a small window; start a multi-party call in a group at any time — others get a prompt to join, and during the call you can mute or unmute, see who is speaking and share your screen.
feature.item6: Notifications you don't miss: new messages use system notifications (sound and vibration can be toggled separately) and conversations carry an unread badge.
feature.item7: Contacts and friends: friend requests, remarks, profile pages and block list, search for people and groups, plus QR-code cards and scanning to add friends or join a group.
feature.item8: Discover > Lingting: online music with thirty songs a day, hot songs, recommended playlists and artists, lyrics, playlists, search and downloads.
feature.item9: Discover > Media: news from several public sources, in list and full-text form; links open in a safe web window and suspicious addresses are flagged first.
feature.item10: Account and security: sign-in credentials are encrypted on your device; switch between accounts, change your password and close your account; chat history is stored on your device and uninstalling does not delete it.
feature.item11: Languages and settings: Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, Spanish, French and German; display, notification and call settings all live under Me > Settings.
feature.item12: On mobile: the app stays online in the background and keeps receiving messages and incoming calls; if the system's battery policy blocks it, the app tells you what to turn on (notification permission, background running, auto-start).
